sinopsis.es: Una familia adinerada espera su cuarto hijo. El padre, ginecólogo, pretende practicarle un aborto a su esposa y esterilizarla, pero una serie de sucesos hace que los hijos vayan muriendo uno a uno. La enorme sombra del protagonista encarna la idea de que su dinero le permite todo y se encoge a medida que él pierde poder.
sinopsis.en: A wealthy family is expecting their fourth child. The father, a gynecologist, intends to perform an abortion on his wife and sterilize her, but a series of events causes the children to die one by one. Pinilla made this film almost entirely on his own, as a test run before his first feature film. The protagonist’s enormous shadow embodies the idea that his money allows him to do anything, and it shrinks as he loses power.
